title: Inno-Versity Presents: Greatness by David Marquet
summary: Retired submarine captain David Marquet explains, with drawings, how he turned the USS Santa Fe around by treating his crew as leaders rather than followers. It summarizes the ideas of his book Turn the Ship Around.
why: Recommended as a short, illustrated take on empowering teams instead of giving orders.

quote.text: Also here's a great speech given by the David Marquet (with drawings!) on the same topic
